summary: Replaces the machine-based post-processor's internal _modal_state dict with a MachineState that is updated before each command is handed to the subclass hooks, adds [] access, .previous and updateState to MachineState, and makes DrillCycleExpander require an established X/Y/Z/ReturnMode (and G0F when strict) and omit F from G0 moves when G0F is unknown.

pages.reason: Path/Post/Processor.py: _modal_state removed; _convert_item_commands now calls machine_state.addCommand(cmd) before convert_command_to_gcode so hooks see the post-command state and machine_state.previous for the prior one; machine_state is None outside use_machine_state() and is reset per section/after tool change and 'str' items; Path/Base/MachineState.py gains [key] access, .previous, updateState and a .get-tolerant M3/M4 S

Path/Post/UtilsParse.py and DrillCycleExpander.py changes alter internal drill-translate tracking (legacy strict=False path, G0 F omitted when G0F unknown); the page does not describe drill-cycle expansion output at that level; opensbp_post.py probe now accepts modal F, which the page does not document

Processor.py/MachineState.py changes affect subclass-author hook semantics documented on mbpp-postprocessor.adoc; this page's 'Writing a machine-based Post-Processor' section is high-level and does not describe _modal_state or MachineState internals
